author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Fifty-Eight! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Patron-favourite Patrick Todoroff (Zona Alfa, When Nightmare's Come) is back with a Space-Truckers themed space adventure game. Love Outlands or Alien? Need that monochrome green text screens to relly believe it's the future? Patrick has you covered. Let's check it out!

Check out the rulebook on Wargames Vault in digital  HERE: https://www.wargamevault.com/en/product/558811/scrapjacks-salvage-and-survival-in-the-big-empty?src=hottest&affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 059 - Scrapjacks by Patrick Todoroff
